scenes.en: ReAct makes language models reason and act together.
scenes.zh: ReAct 让语言模型把推理和行动结合起来。

scenes.en: Reasoning and acting were mostly studied as separate topics.
scenes.zh: 推理和行动此前大多被当作分开的课题来研究。

cards.t: Chain-of-thought is a static black box

scenes.en: ReAct interleaves reasoning traces with task-specific actions.
scenes.zh: ReAct 把推理轨迹和具体任务的行动交错生成。
scenes.evidence: arXiv:2210.03629 · “generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner”

scenes.en: Thoughts guide actions, and actions bring back outside information.
scenes.zh: 思考引导行动，行动又带回外部信息。

scenes.en: On ALFWorld, ReAct beats imitation and reinforcement learning by 34 percent.
scenes.zh: 在 ALFWorld 上，ReAct 比模仿和强化学习方法高出 34%。
scenes.label: Absolute success rate gain on ALFWorld

scenes.note: Based on Yao et al., ReAct, arXiv:2210.03629
scenes.en: Combining reasoning and acting makes models more effective and interpretable.
scenes.zh: 把推理和行动结合起来，让模型更有效、也更可解释。
